metrics.limitations: May be hidden/rounded; not impressions, views, unique people, or earnings
Not dated upload events or cadence when deletions/private video changes occur
Not impressions, unique viewers, monetized playbacks or Shorts-engaged events
YouTube does not count all placements, embedding or off-platform exposures as impressions
Not all-view CTR, purchase conversion or revenue per thousand views
Home, Suggested, Search, External and other categories use product-specific semantics

metrics.denominator: eligible monetized report and covered time
metrics.limitations: Requires YPP permissions, correct reporting currency, adjustments and payment receipts; not available from public stats

hard_stops: Never call a channel newly established merely because it had fewer than 1000 subscribers at baseline.
The 61M July indexed channels and 32.9M September selected channels are overlapping vendor frames, not disjoint samples.
Subscriber growth and net video count changes cannot yield thumbnail impressions, CTR, watch minutes, YPP qualification, buyer conversions or creator profit.
Owner-only Reach impressions and traffic source reports cannot be imputed from public video views.
Zero-subscriber, deleted and non-indexed channels may be missing from vendor indexes and must not be treated as successful zero-income participants.
Impressions vary by counted product surface, language, content format, title/thumbnail and age; fixed windows and consistent eligible exposures are mandatory.
Authorized channel reporting may contain private account data; aggregate privacy-preserving results rather than uploading individual analytics or private creator credentials.
Neither source proves a causal effect of posting more video objects or a probability of new-creator success.
The 38,229,639-video vidIQ first-week distribution is not stratified by channel age or size; its median 234 views is not an estimated median for new creators.
The separate 107-channel preprint measures lifetime channel views with variable follow-up, not first-week video views, so the two under-1k percentages cannot be subtracted or pooled.

For eligible thumbnail impressions YouTube requires at least 50% on-screen visibility for more than one second, and excludes external links, YouTube Kids and some other surfaces; public video plays cannot supply that denominator.

first_week_video_distribution.eligible: Long-form-classified indexed videos with observed day-seven view data and updated metadata in publication window
study_limits: Video-level indexed sample is not conditioned on channel size and cannot estimate small/new channel first-week performance.
Eligible videos require day-seven observed data; deleted, unindexed, unavailable and other missed videos may be absent.
Long-form classification excludes Shorts but does not separately filter livestreams, so results are not strictly long-form on-demand only.
View shares use approximate percentile bands and tied thresholds, not exact fractions of upload-object counts.
First-week public video view events are not thumbnail impressions, unique viewers, engaged views, creator payouts or causal recommendation effects.

first_upload_preprint_comparison.interpretation: 107 keyword-search-selected channels observed at variable follow-up, lifetime channel view counts; not first-week indexed video view percentages
